description: Tucked into a private and serene setting above the heart of Fairfax, 51 Berry Trail offers a rare opportunity to own a multi-unit property in one of Marin County's most iconic outdoor communities. With approximately 1,189 square feet of living space, this unique property combines comfort, flexibility, and the unmatched lifestyle that has made Fairfax a destination for nature lovers and mountain biking enthusiasts from around the world.  Immerse your life in nature and color as you wake each morning surrounded by rolling hills, towering trees, and the vibrant energy of one of Northern California's most beloved small towns. The upper residence features 2 bedrooms and 1 full bath, highlighted by an updated kitchen, new carpet, and upgraded windows that frame peaceful views overlooking the town of Fairfax and surrounding hillsides. Natural light fills the living spaces, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere that perfectly complements the home's tranquil surroundings.  The lower unit offers an additional 1 bedroom, full bath, and a bright kitchen with dining area, filled with abundant morning light. Ideal for extended family, guests, or supplemental income, the lower level presents exceptional flexibility for today's buyers. With current rental rates in Fairfax, the unit offers income potential of at least $2,500 per month, creating an outstanding opportunity for homeowners seeking both lifestyle and investment value.  Located just a five-minute walk to vibrant downtown Fairfax, the property offers the perfect balance of privacy and convenience. Enjoy easy access to beloved local cafes, restaurants, live music venues, artisan shops, and community events while still feeling immersed in nature. Step outside your door and into the birthplace of mountain biking, where miles of scenic trails, open space, and the beauty of Mount Tamalpais await.  Whether you are searching for a primary residence with rental income potential, a flexible multi-generational living opportunity, or an investment in one of Marin's most desirable communities, 51 Berry Trail delivers exceptional value and lifestyle appeal. This is more than a home  it is a gateway to the relaxed, adventurous spirit that defines Fairfax living.
